name: geominex
description: GeoMineX — AI-assisted document intelligence platform for coal mining subsidiaries. Repository root.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.audit:ci: npm --prefix backend run audit:ci && npm --prefix frontend run audit:ci
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
